answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Decay: each agent identity resolves to a verified operator through a signed binding key, and when identities from one operator are flagged as coordinated, the operator's whole reputation balance decays at dawn each epoch by a factor scaled to flagged fraction, throttling all its agents. A sable badge marks operators under decay. The mesa cap limits any operator to one active agent per verified credential, so a sybil farm costs a fresh credential plus reputation reseeding per identity, paid by the operator.
